items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-16
items.q: He came down to New Orleans and he sold them a bill of goods to Myra Menville and Dr. Sushant.

ctx.x: You don't see anything in front of me that I take notes from, only just from what comes to my mind. That's why I don't have it in chronological order. I can only tell you what I can think of at the time. Maybe my talk may be gobbled up a little bit, that I might put this one before the other one, the other one before the other one. But I am telling you the true facts of this music. It was in Chicago where I changed the rhythm. They had a certain dance team. They were doing a castle walk. And up in the north,…
Can you hold it a second?

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: These carpetbaggers are aided in New Orleans by Ms. Myra Menville and Dr. Sushan... We have two such people in New Orleans, Ms. Myra Menville, Dr. Edmond Sushon, who operate the New Orleans Jazz Club

ctx.x: Well, that'll show you what kind of people that the jazz club has and at the head of it. He wrote me in 1949 that I have proof that we were the original Dixieland jazz band. Now he's writing up on this guy that he is the original Dixieland jazz band. They give him a cup for his presence of being in the jazz club. What wonderful people they have in New Orleans. All they were doing was to start integration, what they call the mixing bowl. They had started that up north 22 years ago, 20 years ago, by Marshall Stein.…

This is a letter headed Dominique James Nicola Rocca, 2218 Constant Street, New Orleans, Louisiana, 13, January the 9th, 1955. Senator Eastland of Mississippi, Washington, D.C. Honorable Senator Eastland, Hoping you may direct your committee attention to the propaganda that has been going on in New Orleans. Because wherever there is smoke, there must be fire. These people have given out history, read jazz music, as compiled by the Northern Coppetbaggers, NAACP through Bill Handy, trying to give the Negro culture…
I want you to read this here about a nine-man court.
